Title: Associating a measuring parameter with an item
Preconditions: User is logged in and has permission to edit items, at least one item and one measuring parameter exist
Steps:
1. Navigate to the item management page. 2. Click on an item in the list. 3. Click the 'Add Measuring Parameter' button. 4. Select a measuring parameter. 5. Click the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Item name: Test Item, Measuring parameter name: Test Parameter
Expected Result: The measuring parameter is successfully associated with the item

Title: Attempt to create an item without required fields
Preconditions: User is logged in and on the 'Create New Item' screen
Steps:
1. Leave all required fields blank. 2. Click the 'Save' button.

Test Data: No data entered in any field
Expected Result: System displays an error message indicating that required fields are missing and prevents the item from being saved.

Title: Attempt to create an item with invalid data types in required fields
Preconditions: User is logged in and on the 'Create New Item' screen
Steps:
1. Enter text in a field that expects a numeric value (e.g., 'abc' in a 'Quantity' field). 2. Click the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Quantity: 'abc'
Expected Result: System displays an error message indicating that the field must be a valid number and prevents the item from being saved.

Title: Attempt to create an item with malformed format in date fields
Preconditions: User is logged in and on the 'Create New Item' screen
Steps:
1. Enter an invalid date format (e.g., '31/02/2023') in a date field. 2. Click the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Date: '31/02/2023'
Expected Result: System displays an error message indicating that the date format is invalid and prevents the item from being saved.

Title: Attempt to create a duplicate item
Preconditions: User is logged in, an item with the same unique identifier (e.g., barcode or SKU) already exists in the system, and user is on the 'Create New Item' screen
Steps:
1. Enter the exact same unique identifier (e.g., barcode or SKU) as an existing item. 2. Fill in other fields with valid data. 3. Click the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Barcode/SKU: '1234567890' (already exists)
Expected Result: System displays an error message indicating that the item already exists and prevents the duplicate item from being saved.

Title: Attempt to update an item without required fields
Preconditions: User is logged in, an item exists in the system, and user is on the 'Edit Item' screen for that item
Steps:
1. Clear all required fields. 2. Click the 'Save' button.

Test Data: No data entered in any required field
Expected Result: System displays an error message indicating that required fields are missing and prevents the item from being updated.

Title: Attempt to update an item to an invalid status transition
Preconditions: User is logged in, an item exists in the system with a status of 'Finalized', and user is on the 'Edit Item' screen for that item
Steps:
1. Attempt to change the item status from 'Finalized' to 'Draft'. 2. Click the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Status: Change from 'Finalized' to 'Draft'
Expected Result: System displays an error message indicating that the status transition is not allowed and prevents the update.

Title: Attempt to create or update an item without proper authorization
Preconditions: User is not logged in or does not have the required role (e.g., 'Tailor' or 'Admin') to create/update items
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Create New Item' or 'Edit Item' screen. 2. Attempt to fill in and save item details.

Test Data: Any valid or invalid data
Expected Result: System redirects the user to the login page or displays an 'Access Denied' error message, preventing any changes.
